financial.employment: Home Care Worker (State of Oregon Department of Human Services - Seniors and People with Disabilities Office)
financial.payroll_issuer: State of Oregon DHS / Seniors & People with Disabilities
financial.payroll_deductions: Standard withholdings, SEIU Union Dues, OregonSaves retirement contribution
financial.savings_and_pto_notes: Lives paycheck to paycheck. OregonSaves retirement and accrued PTO balances are routinely drawn down to cover income gaps when hours fluctuate, leaving no liquid savings reserve.
financial.hardship_statement: Applicant earns $21.25/hr working ~32 hours per 2-week pay period ($680.00 gross / ~$533.82 net biweekly). Net pay reflects deductions for taxes, union dues, and OregonSaves retirement contributions (which are regularly drawn down to cover living expenses during spotty hours). Applicant lives paycheck to paycheck with < $100 liquid assets. Financial hardship is exacerbated by Defendant City's 510-day illegal water shutoff, concrete vault placement, and fee-stacked administrative surcharges. Applicant cannot pay the $405 federal filing fee without forfeiting basic necessities of life.
